ops.quote: AsymFormer uses an asymmetrical backbone for multimodal feature extraction
a Local Attention-Guided Feature Selection (LAFS) module is used to selectively fuse features
selectively fuse features from different modalities by leveraging their dependencies
a Cross-Modal Attention-Guided Feature Correlation Embedding (CMA) module is introduced to further extract cross-modal representations
AsymFormer demonstrates competitive results with 54.1% mIoU on NYUv2
AsymFormer improves real-time semantic segmentation accuracy using RGB-D multi-modal information without substantially increasing network complexity
AsymFormer can strike a balance between high accuracy and efficiency
